QuestInfo.name: [9th Anniversary Par-tay] Monster Huntin'
QuestInfo.0: There is still a ton a work to do to prepare for the party. Go talk to Cassandra.
QuestInfo.1: Hunt #r500#k monsters in the field and then talk to Inkie at the 9th Anniversary Commemorative Park. Just remember, you have to fight monsters around your level. #bNo more than 11 lower or 21 higher#k!
QuestInfo.2: Now that the monsters are defeated, what next?

npc.0: Go talk to Inkie at the 9th Anniversary Park. You can use the Dimensional Mirror or the Teleport Rock that I gave you.
